mentions.name: Maxxmod
mentions.description: This Chrome extension improves the YouTube experience by removing distractions (hiding Shorts and cleaning up search results) and adding tools and shortcuts such as a volume booster, screenshot tool, quick access to Picture-in-Picture, and playback speed controls. It also includes an option to stop comment GIFs from autoplaying, playing them only on demand via a play button.
mentions.problem: YouTube viewers are distracted by Shorts, cluttered search results, and autoplaying GIFs in comments.
mentions.source_excerpt: A month and half ago launched Maxxmod, a Chrome extension that improves the YouTube experience by removing distractions (hiding Shorts and cleaning up search results) and adding new tools and shortcuts (volume booster, screenshot tool, quick access to Picture-in-Picture and playback speed controls).
